description: A static utility class 'TestingUtils' containing methods to configure logging, generate trace file names, create logger factories, wait asynchronously until a condition is met, multiply TimeSpan objects, and configure thread pool settings for storage tests in the Orleans testing framework.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: A static class providing various test utility methods for logging, file management, task coordination, and environment configuration within the Orleans testing framework.

methods.name: ConfigureDefaultLoggingBuilder
methods.description: Configures the provided ILoggingBuilder with a FileLoggerProvider that logs to the specified file path.

methods.name: CreateTraceFileName
methods.description: Creates a log file name for a specific node and cluster, ensuring the logs directory exists.

methods.name: CreateDefaultLoggerFactory
methods.description: Creates an ILoggerFactory configured with a FileLoggerProvider that logs to the specified file path, with optional filters.

methods.name: WaitUntilAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until a predicate returns true or a timeout occurs, optionally delaying between retries.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies a TimeSpan by a scalar value and returns the resulting TimeSpan.

methods.name: ConfigureThreadPoolSettingsForStorageTests
methods.description: Configures ThreadPool and ServicePointManager settings to optimize storage test environments.
